natural_body: Deep discounts spike signups +31% but risk renewal. Use tactically with guardrails.

first.rationale: Simplifying onboarding directly addresses both the 4% completion decline and the 6% activation decline, with prior evidence of faster time-to-value and durable SMB activation gains. It is more aligned with sustainable qualified revenue than matching the competitor through deep discounts, which carry renewal risk. Run a controlled experiment and monitor downstream qualification, conversion, and retention so improved completion does not mask lower-value activation.
